name: Refinishing vs Resurfacing vs Restoration: Terms Explained
title-tag: Refinishing vs Resurfacing vs Restoration: Terms Explained
meta-description: Refinishing, resurfacing, restoration — only one has a fixed meaning. A Seattle-area contractor explains what each job does, costs, and how to compare quotes.
post-summary: March 31, 2027 · Refinishing means sanding to bare wood. Resurfacing is a marketing word that usually means a recoat. Restoration means repairs first, then refinishing. Here’s what each job physically does, what it costs on our price list, and the four questions that make three quotes comparable.
